g:HTMLPanel.p: FloatingLabel puts the label inside its control and floats it up once the control has a value.

d:Example.heading: Text inputs
d:Example.description: Give the `FloatingLabel` a `text` and one control; it links them and adds the `placeholder` Bootstrap needs.

d:Example.heading: Text areas
d:Example.description: Set the height of a `TextArea` to make room for more lines.

d:Example.heading: Selects
d:Example.description: On a `ListBox` the label always stays floated.

d:Example.heading: In a grid
d:Example.description: Floating labels work inside grid columns.
